GOLD PRICES SLIDE, TITAN AND MUTHOOT FALL

Titan, Muthoot Finance and Kalyan Jewellers saw their stocks drop up to 4% on 20 November 2026 as gold prices slipped. Analysts say the price correction could force jewellery makers to sell higher‑cost inventory, risking losses.
